canonical_answers: Multiplying by r gives r²=6r cos θ. | Thus x²+y²=6x. | Completing the square gives (x−3)²+y²=9. | The graph is a circle centered at (3,0) with radius 3. | For cos θ<0 the formula produces negative r, which maps to the opposite direction. | Restricting to −π/2≤θ≤π/2 traces the circle with r≥0.
